sloka: नृत्यन्ति स्म हसन्ति स्म गायन्ति स्म च सैनिका: ।समन्तात् परिधावन्ति माल्योपेता: सहस्रश: ॥ २.९१.६१॥
transliteration: nṛtyanti sma hasanti sma gāyanti sma ca sainikā: ।samantāt paridhāvanti mālyopetā: sahasraśa: ॥ 2.91.61॥

translations.english: Having enjoyed the hospitality of Bharadwaja the foot soldiers, horse and elephant riders made utterances ignoring their leaders.
